avatar.name: Aeon ★ Aha
avatar.description:
Cries and comedy intertwine, and the deathly still cosmos awakens to daybreak in a farce.
Stepping back onto the stage of the Path, I tear off the god's mask. Who is Aha? I am Aha!
To play, to trick, to hunt... Please bear witness to an improv tour where humans and gods dance as one!

skills.name: Starfrost, Showtime!
skills.description: Deals ****1[i]%**** Quantum **Elation DMG** to one designated enemy target.

skills.name: This Emanator Was Certified by Aha™
skills.description: Enables one designated ally character (excluding this unit) to gain the "Emanator of Elation" state, then immediately launches **Follow-up ATK**, dealing ****2[i]%**** Quantum **Elation DMG** to all enemies. The "Emanator of Elation" state lasts for the entire battle until it switches to the next target. The target with the "Emanator of Elation" state has their Elation stat increased by ****1[i]%**** and, at the start of their turn, enables Aeon ★ Aha to gain **6[i]** point(s) of "Wishpower."

skills.name: Aha! Let There Be Laughter
skills.description: **Aha**'s **action advances** by **5[i]%**. Aeon ★ Aha gains the "Faces of Elation" state, lasting for **6[i]** turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Aeon ★ Aha's every turn. Deals ****2[i]%**** Quantum **Elation DMG** to all enemies. Then, deals **3[i]** instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing ****4[i]%**** Quantum **Elation DMG** to one random enemy.

skills.name: Work Wonders with THEM
skills.description: Can activate Ultimate after "Wishpower" reaches **8[i]**. After reaching its upper limit, Wishpower can still overflow up to **11[i]**. After using Basic ATK, Skill, or Elation Skill, Aeon ★ Aha gains **7[i]** "Wishpower." After allies' **Punchline** reaches **2[i]** for the first time, Aeon ★ Aha will immediately gain **3[i]** "Wishpower" and then increase all allies' CRIT DMG by ****9[i]%****, lasting for **10[i]** turn(s). This can trigger again after **Aha**'s turn ends.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: ABRACADABRA!
skills.description: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension around this unit, lasting for **2[i]** second(s). Enemies within this Special Dimension get inflicted with "Optical Illusion." Once inflicted with "Optical Illusion," they cannot detect ally targets. After entering combat, **Aha** immediately gains 1 **extra turn** where a fixed amount of **1[i]** **Punchline** is taken into account. This turn does not consume **Punchline**. Only 1 dimension effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

skills.name: Yes Aha At Full Moon
skills.description: Always gets used at the end of Aha Instant regardless of Participant ID. Deals ****1[i]%**** Quantum **Elation DMG** to all enemies, and deals **True DMG** based on **2[i]%** of total non-True DMG dealt by ally targets during this Aha Instant, distributed evenly among all enemies.

skills.name: Faces of Elation ★ Ex Nihilo
skills.description: While holding the "Faces of Elation" state, Aeon ★ Aha enables allies' ****Path of Elation to ascend****, and enhances **Punchline** and "**Certified Banger**" into **Bliss** and "**Party Trick**," respectively. **Bliss** recovers ****1[i]%**** of its consumed amount when Aha Instant ends. During "Faces of Elation," Aeon ★ Aha's CRIT Rate increases by ****3[i]%****, and the DMG dealt ignores ****2[i]%**** of the enemy target's DEF.

skills.name: The True Story of Aha
skills.description: When Aeon ★ Aha or a teammate deals DMG, additionally applies the **"Elation Debt"** effect onto the enemy target, equal to **1[i]%** of their HP loss. **Elation Debt** persists through the enemy target's phase transition, capped at **3[i]%** of the target's Max HP.

ranks.name: A Stacked Deck of Sorrow and Joy
ranks.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.description: Enemy targets always carry an **"Elation Debt"** effect that claims at least **1[i]%** of their Max HP. After Aeon ★ Aha uses Ultimate for the first time, **Aha**'s **action advances** by **3[i]%**, and Aha gains **2[i]** **Punchline**.

avatar.name: Ellen
avatar.description:
Diligently slacking off, punctually late... Today is just another day of this working gal getting defeated by her alarm clock!
Despite having to do holiday homework even in another world, and frequently falling asleep standing up despite being the tour group's bodyguard...
But please refrain from messing with her. Aside from that languid tail, she's also got razor-sharp shark teeth.

skills.name: Saw Teeth Trimming
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Ellen's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Blizzard du Jour
skills.description: Gains **3[i]** point(s) of "Shark's Gotta Bite." Inflicts the "Bite Mark" state on one designated enemy target, increasing the Basic ATK DMG taken by ****5[i]%****. Then, deals Ice DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Ellen's ATK to that target, while simultaneously dealing Ice DMG equal to ****2[i]%**** of Ellen's ATK to adjacent targets. At the start of an ally target's turn or when they take action, if there are no enemy targets in the "Bite Mark" state, Ellen causes the enemy target with the highest HP to become afflicted with "Bite Mark."

skills.name: Welcome to the Ice Age
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Ellen's ATK to all enemies. Additionally deals Ice DMG equal to ****2[i]%**** of Ellen's ATK to enemy targets in the "Bite Mark" state. After using Ultimate, increases the DMG dealt by Ellen's next use of "Ice Sea Diving" by ****3[i]%****.

skills.name: Better Call Bangboo
skills.description:
At the start of the battle, summons "Sharkboo" with an initial SPD of **1[i]** points. When "Sharkboo" takes action, it launches **Follow-Up ATK**, dealing Ice DMG equal to ****2[i]%**** of Ellen's ATK to one enemy. "Sharkboo" will prioritize attacking targets under the "Bite Mark" state.
Ellen has a "Shark's Gotta Bite" limit of 6 points. When an ally character uses a Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate to attack, Ellen gains **3[i]** point(s) of "Shark's Gotta Bite."
"Ice Sea Diving" is unable to gain "Shark's Gotta Bite."

skills.name: Zoned In on Zero
skills.description:
When **Astra Yao** is on the team:
After Ellen uses her Ultimate, she automatically uses "Ice Sea Diving" 1 time, then immediately triggers **Astra Yao's** "Minuet Pianissimo" and grants Astra Yao 1 **extra turn**.
After **Astra Yao** uses her Ultimate, she automatically uses "Cadenza Cascade" 1 time, then immediately triggers Ellen's "Saw Teeth Trimming," granting Ellen 1 point of "Shark's Gotta Bite," and then triggers **Ellen's** "Ice Sea Diving" 1 more time.
When attacks triggered by "Zoned In on Zero" select a primary target, both Ellen and **Astra Yao** prioritize enemy targets in the "Bite Mark" state.
Basic ATKs triggered by "Zoned In on Zero" do not recover Skill Points, and "Ice Sea Diving" triggered by "Zoned In on Zero" does not consume "Shark's Gotta Bite."
After Ellen or **Astra Yao** uses their Ultimate, dispels the other's **Crowd Control debuffs**.

skills.name: Roaming Hunt
skills.description: Using the Technique grants the "Roaming" state for **1[i]** seconds. While in the "Roaming" state, this unit moves forward rapidly, blocking all enemy attacks while moving. Using an attack or stopping while in the "Roaming" state ends it prematurely. After actively attacking an enemy and entering combat, this unit gains **2[i]** "Shark's Gotta Bite" and regenerates **3[i]** Energy, and deals Ice DMG equal to **4[i]%** of Ellen's ATK to all enemies.

skills.name: Ice Sea Diving
skills.description:
Consumes all "Shark's Gotta Bite," inflicting "Bite Mark" on the primary target and dealing Ice DMG equal to ****1[i]%**** of Ellen's ATK to it. Deals Ice DMG equal to ****2[i]%**** of Ellen's ATK to adjacent targets.
Activation Condition: Enhanced Basic ATK activates when "Shark's Gotta Bite" is 3 or higher. If the "Shark's Gotta Bite" consumed exceeds 3, each additional "Shark's Gotta Bite" consumed deals 1 instance of Ice DMG equal to ****3[i]%**** of Ellen's ATK to one random enemy, prioritizing the primary target of this "Ice Sea Diving" and its adjacent targets.
This attack does not recover Skill Points.

tree.description: At the start of combat, Ellen gains 3 points of "Shark's Gotta Bite." Once "Shark's Gotta Bite" reaches its limit, for every 2 points of excess "Shark's Gotta Bite" accumulated, it is recorded as 1 point of "Heat," up to a maximum of 2 points. After Ellen consumes 6 points of "Shark's Gotta Bite" to use "Ice Sea Diving," she clears all "Heat," with every 1 point of "Heat" cleared recovering 1 point of "Shark's Gotta Bite."

tree.description: After "Sharkboo" attacks a target, Ellen gains 1 point of "Shark's Gotta Bite." This effect can trigger at most once per "Sharkboo" action. After Ellen consumes 6 points of "Shark's Gotta Bite" to use "Ice Sea Diving," for every 1 point of "Heat" cleared, "Sharkboo's" **action advances** by **1[i]%**.

ranks.description: When Ellen consumes 6 "Shark's Gotta Bite" to unleash "Ice Sea Diving," all DMG dealt by this "Ice Sea Diving" ignores **3[i]%** of the target's DEF. After this attack ends, Ellen's **action advances** by **1[i]%** and she recovers **2[i]** "Shark's Gotta Bite."

ranks.name: Pinch a Smile at the Mirror
ranks.description: After Ellen uses "Ice Sea Diving," "Sharkboo's" **action advances** by **100%**. When using each attack, "Sharkboo" regenerates **1[i]** Energy and **3[i]** "Shark's Gotta Bite" for Ellen, and increases the CRIT DMG dealt by her next "Ice Sea Diving" by **2[i]%**. This effect does not stack.

ranks.name: The Morning Melts Sweet
ranks.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**.

ranks.name: A Heart Served All the Same
ranks.description: When Ellen uses "Ice Sea Diving," every point of "Shark's Gotta Bite" consumed increases the Ice RES PEN of all DMG dealt by this "Ice Sea Diving" by **1[i]%**.

ranks.name: The Ocean Swims Her Home
ranks.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. **15**. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. **10**.

ranks.name: Fed, Rested, and Left Alone
ranks.description: When Ellen uses "Ice Sea Diving," Ice **RES PEN** increases by **4[i]%**, and the number of instances of DMG dealt to random single enemy targets increases by **5[i]**. After Ellen uses her Ultimate, she gains **1[i]** stack(s) of "Revelry Instant." The max limit of "Revelry Instant" stacks is **2[i]**. While possessing "Revelry Instant," after Ellen's turn or "Zoned In on Zero" ends, 1 stack of "Revelry Instant" is immediately consumed, and Ellen immediately gains 1 extra turn and regenerates **3[i]** "Shark's Gotta Bite."

avatar.name: Astra Yao
avatar.description:
The stars take their seats for her, the lights dim for her, and the most dazzling voice in New Eridu pierces the sky.
Offstage, she spends her vacation drifting like a cloud beneath the arcadia's clear sky.
"Whoever you are, wherever you're from... this song is dedicated to the one and only you!"

When the wearer consumes at least <unbreak>200</unbreak> Energy at once to use their Ultimate, they gain "Iced Drink," lasting for 3 turns. While "Iced Drink" is active, Basic ATK and Ultimate DMG dealt by the wearer ignores <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of the target's DEF. When the wearer has both "Snack" and "Iced Drink" simultaneously, they additionally gain "Good Mood," and Basic ATK and Ultimate DMG dealt additionally ignores <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of the target's DEF.

weapon.name: Shine Bright Like Her
weapon.refinements: Increases the wearer's ATK by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> and Energy Regeneration Rate by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>. After the wearer uses their Ultimate, if the wearer is not the first character in the team lineup, advances the action of the first character in the team lineup by <unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak>. If the Ultimate consumes <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> Energy or more, the wearer gains "Our Melody," increasing the CRIT DMG of all allies by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>, lasting for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s).

relics.name: Moment of Joy's Eternal Stage
relics.description: The Planar Sphere encapsulates the stage in the realm of the Moment of Joy, where every laugh and every tear is etched with a moment Aha holds dear.
relics.two: Increases the wearer's SPD by **6%**. When the wearer's Elation stat reaches **40%** or higher, advances the wearer's action by **40%** immediately upon entering combat.
story: "What makes joy so precious is that it's always but a fleeting moment~" THEY will not forget the thrill of the hunt, chasing that vicious beast. When frail humans huddled in the cracks between leviathans, THEY dared to slip into the beast's maw and steal that precious "Aftertaste." THEY will not forget the freedom of traversing the cosmos. Boarding that meteor-like Express, the young god set out on a journey of no return, ultimately parting ways at the end of the world. THEY will not forget the cry of a newborn child. Sorrow, much like laughter, can bid farewell to life, yet it may also be a gift from new life to the silent cosmos. THEY will not forget the Fool's sincere laughter. In those golden eras, humanity faced terror with courage and dissolved despair with humor. ... When the mask slipped away from the one beneath it, even THEY had been scarred by that creeping growth of "desire." And so, THEY transformed the vanishing past into a fleeting eternity, treasuring it within this secret arcadia... Every moment serves to remind THEM that the curtain has yet to fall on THEIR performance, and that "Elation" was always meant to be a name for humanity. THEY yearn for someone to journey here and share in the spectacle of this never-ending play.

relics.name: Moment of Joy's Magic Prop
relics.description: A magic prop preserved in the realm of the Moment of Joy. Ribbons entwine THEIR fingertips as the stars spin and sing for THEM.
relics.two: Increases the wearer's SPD by **6%**. When the wearer's Elation stat reaches **40%** or higher, advances the wearer's action by **40%** immediately upon entering combat.
story: "Can you even remember how many ribbons you've tossed? With magic, it's not about proving anything, it's about believing." Sometimes, THEY look down from the high heavens as Wishpower flows and gathers. Sometimes, THEY sit in the audience, waving glow sticks for a breathtaking performance. Sometimes, THEY appear at a street corner, tucking the hint of a riddle into the bottom of a surprise box. Sometimes, THEY don a mask to play the part of an omnipotent god. For guests hungry for a little fun, THEY serve up a mixed drink. For travelers chasing the stars, THEY lay out an astral chart. ... THEY wander through the vast sea of humanity, scattering seeds of wishes among the crowd. A miracle is like a spark of hope. When people gaze up at the moon, they can harvest the fuel to change reality. "If the Trailblaze is a gentle push when people are confounded, then the Elation is that little pull when they fall!" For a thousand Amber Eras, "the Elation" has never been the grand protagonist, but rather a divine spark clinging to all things. People cannot put its true essence into words. They can only hold onto blurry memories of those instants that could be called "the Elation": love arriving in the hazy twilight, stars surging up in the dark, a cool breeze on a summer evening, and the moment of recovering something lost... Those truly are magical moments, dyeing all the pale fragments of life with a color worth cherishing. Do you remember those moments? Are you smiling too? "Aha... the magic has already done its work."

relics.name: ASC Dark Fissure
relics.description: Sealed within the Planar Sphere is a mysterious fissure of the IPC's Anomaly Supervision & Containment Center. Within this facility, reason outranks intuition, and rules outrank reason.
relics.two: Increases the wearer's SPD by **6%**. When the wearer's SPD reaches **145** or higher, increases all allies' Break Effect by **18%** after entering combat. This effect cannot stack.
story: "The greatest danger in the ASC Center is never the contained, but your own curiosity." When the facility's researchers receive their hefty copy of Top Secret: Employee Handbook, this quote on the title page is bound to be the very first thing they notice. A quick flip through the pages, and they'll soon understand exactly what it means— Containment Object ASC-028, "Playmate Seeker" Trait: The Playmate Seeker appears to be a harmless household service robot. It designates any sapient being within a twenty-meter radius as its "playmate." The chosen "playmate" must survive a barrage of firearms and successfully escape its pursuit. After this, they will swap roles every five minutes until one party finds and destroys the other. Containment Procedure: Contain the Playmate Seeker in a room mirrored on all six sides. There, it will play with itself forever, yet never be able to touch the "playmate" in the mirror. Containment Object ASC-032, "Stealth Cloak" !! IMPORTANT REMINDER: DO NOT FORGET THIS OBJECT EXISTS !! Trait: ASC-032 will tempt researchers into putting it on, and whoever does so will immediately vanish from sight. This is not optical invisibility under the laws of physics. Rather, it causes observers to overlook the wearer's very existence, subconsciously concocting countless reasons to justify their disappearance. ... Of course, the mysteries of the ASC Center extend far beyond the anomalies it contains. Its very existence seems to be an enigma, with access tightly locked down by its shadowy director, Yabuli. Rumor has it that the ASC Center is itself one massive containment object, connected to a fissure no one has ever set foot in. But the researchers stationed here usually have no desire to stare into the truth, thanks to far too many cautionary tales: "This is the Anomaly Supervision & Containment Center. When you step through these doors, please leave all cognition of common sense behind."

relics.name: ASC Negative Film
relics.description: ASC Center's Object Zero usually manifests as a projector, yet few know what truly lies beneath.
relics.two: Increases the wearer's SPD by **6%**. When the wearer's SPD reaches **145** or higher, increases all allies' Break Effect by **18%** after entering combat. This effect cannot stack.
story: The ASC Center houses a vast and complex array of anomalies, yet "Object Zero" remains a mystery few can unravel. Its archive records the information Yabuli went to great lengths to obtain— Containment Object ASC-0, usually manifests as a film projector. Containment Class: Extreme. It boasts unprecedented stability. Under the protection of a special substance, it rarely reacts chemically with other matter, which also means it cannot be dismantled. Therefore, researchers highly suspect it only interacts with certain predetermined targets. During a random moment of chaos, Object Zero briefly resonated with another contained object, the remnants of a compass excavated from a certain ruin. "I heard it... the echoes of surging waves, the hiss of a flickering screen, a faint sigh..." That was all the shaken researcher could report. After a few brief words, Object Zero once again returned to quiescence. No one knows why Yabuli, or even the IPC, takes such a keen interest in Object Zero. An anonymous conspiracy theorist once claimed on a deep web forum that it was all just a lie cooked up by Yabuli to lock down IPC resources. Others say the IPC has long been dissatisfied with stagnant profits, and that Object Zero holds the secret to a massive market. Once they get their hands on it, the destiny of this cosmos will change along with it...
